scenes.name: Agent finds it
scenes.title: John needs a dataset.
scenes.body: His AI agent finds a useful developer dataset for $10. John wants the file, but he doesn't want to hand over control of his wallet.

captions.text: His AI agent finds a useful developer dataset for $10.
John wants the file, but he doesn't want to hand over control of his wallet.

scenes.name: No blank check
scenes.title: His money. His decision.
scenes.body: An agent shouldn't have unrestricted spending power. John wants to buy this one file, not give an agent permission to spend whenever it wants.

captions.text: An agent shouldn't have unrestricted spending power.
John wants to buy this one file, not give an agent permission to spend whenever it wants.

scenes.name: John says yes
scenes.title: One file. One approval.
scenes.body: John sees the seller, the $10 price and the file he's getting. He sets a maximum source spend of 11 USDC and approves this one purchase.

captions.text: John sees the seller, the $10 price and the file he's getting.
He sets a maximum source spend of 11 USDC and approves this one purchase.

scenes.name: Payment verified
scenes.title: Paid on Arbitrum. Received on Base.
scenes.body: John sends about $10.11 from his Arbitrum wallet. NEAR Intents handles the cross-chain payment, and RouteTill verifies that the merchant received exactly $10 on Base.

captions.text: John sends about $10.11 from his Arbitrum wallet.
NEAR Intents handles the cross-chain payment, and RouteTill verifies that the merchant received exactly $10 on Base.

scenes.name: File + proof
scenes.title: Delivered. With proof.
scenes.body: RouteTill verifies the merchant payment, delivers the correct dataset exactly once, and issues a signed Purchase Passport anyone can check.

captions.text: RouteTill verifies the merchant payment, delivers the correct dataset exactly once, and issues a signed Purchase Passport anyone can check.

scenes.name: Break-It Lab
scenes.title: Five security checks. No real funds.
scenes.body: Judges can also try five security checks. RouteTill rejects changed recipients, over-limit payments and reused approvals. Twenty notifications produce one entitlement. Tampered evidence fails verification.

captions.text: Judges can also try five security checks.
RouteTill rejects changed recipients, over-limit payments and reused approvals.

scenes.name: RouteTill
scenes.title: One purchase. The proof to keep.
scenes.body: John got the right file. The seller got paid. And RouteTill has the proof.
